mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (email, password_hash, nickname, phone, role, status) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT region_id, name FROM region WHERE parent_region_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name
SELECT r.region_id, r.name FROM user_region ur JOIN region r ON r.region_id = ur.region_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ur.region_id
SELECT sport_id AS sportId, name AS name FROM sport ORDER BY sport_id
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM sport WHERE sport_id = #{sportId}
SELECT s.sport_id AS sportId, s.name AS name FROM user_preferred_sport ups JOIN sport s ON s.sport_id = ups.sport_id WHERE ups.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_preferred_sport (user_id, sport_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sportId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sport_id = VALUES(sport_id)
